hadith_en: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said: "If an individual becomes intoxicated, flog him; then if he becomes intoxicated again, flog him; then if he becomes intoxicated again, flog him; and if he returns a fourth time, then kill him.".
syarah_en: Drinking alcohol is one of the prohibitions that entail a fixed legal punishment (Hadd) set by Allah.In this Hadith, the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said: "If an individual becomes intoxicated, flog him", meaning that if a Muslim drinks alcohol, the prescribed (Hadd) of flogging is to be carried out on him. The intended meaning of flogging is to strike the one being punished with a whip, a palm branch, or something similar.The narration continues, "then if he becomes intoxicated again, flog him", meaning that if he drinks it a second time, the (Hadd) of flogging is again to be carried out on him.The narration then reads, "then if he becomes intoxicated, flog him". That is, if he returns to drinking it a third time, the prescribed (Hadd) of flogging is once again to be carried out on him.Then, the narration continues, "and if he returns a fourth time, then kill him". This means if he drinks alcohol a fourth time, and the prescribed (Hadd) of flogging was carried out on him each previous time, then his (Hadd) this time is death. There is a difference of opinion regarding the ruling on the one who drinks alcohol a fourth time, whether he should be flogged or killed as a Hadd or a Ta`zir for the public interest. The Ijma` (consensus) has settled on the establishment of the prescribed (Hadd) for alcohol, and that it does not include the death penalty, except that the disagreement remains regarding whether the prescribed flogging should be forty or eighty lashes..
